# HAProxy — root-to-custom-context-servlet-mapping

Proxy at /ui/, app on /app context with VAADIN_URL_MAPPING=/ui/*. The Hilla paths strip the servlet mapping and gain the context prefix; everything else only gains /app. Here the general rule runs first and the Hilla rule fixes up what it produced, because an ACL re-evaluated after a rewrite no longer sees the path that matched it.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/ui/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

HAProxy config (`haproxy/http/root-to-custom-context-servlet-mapping/vaadin.cfg`), mounted as
`conf.d/10-vaadin.cfg`:

```haproxy
# Proxy at /ui/, app on the /app context with the Vaadin servlet on /ui/*. The
# mirror image of custom-to-root-context-servlet-mapping: the public URL drops
# the context prefix instead of adding one.
#
# The Hilla paths have to lose the servlet mapping and gain the context —
# /ui/HILLA/* becomes /app/HILLA/* — while everything else only gains /app.
# See vaadin/hilla#289.
#
# Here the order is the other way round from the sibling: the general rule runs
# first and the Hilla rule fixes up what it produced. Doing it the other way
# would need a condition to stop the general rule prefixing /app a second time,
# because an ACL re-evaluated after a rewrite no longer sees the path that
# matched it.
frontend vaadin-in from vaadin-front
    bind :80

    # /ui/HILLA/x -> /app/ui/HILLA/x, /ui/foo -> /app/ui/foo, /VAADIN/x -> /app/VAADIN/x
    http-request set-path /app%[path]
    # ... and then /app/ui/HILLA/x -> /app/HILLA/x. Only matches what the rule
    # above produced, so the two cannot fire on the same path twice.
    http-request replace-path ^/app/ui(/(HILLA|connect)/.*) /app\1

    default_backend vaadin-app

backend vaadin-app from vaadin
    http-response replace-header Location ^(https?://[^/]+)?/app(/.*) \1\2
    # Anchored on the end of the value: Tomcat writes `Path=/app`, with no
    # trailing slash, so a regex expecting `/app/` matches nothing and the
    # browser at / never sends the session cookie back.
    http-response replace-header Set-Cookie (.*;\s*[Pp]ath=)/app(;.*)?$ \1/\2
    server vaadin vaadin:8080
```

The `global` section, and the two `defaults` sections this file
inherits from, come from the shared
[haproxy-base.cfg](../../haproxy-base.cfg), mounted read-only beside
it as `conf.d/00-base.cfg`. Base and scenario only parse as a pair.
